# Baseline releases whose grain contracts this repository is knowingly allowed to differ from.
# One tag per line, then a reason after a space. A waiver applies only while that tag is the baseline, so it
# stops mattering as soon as a later release is cut; delete the line then.
v19.123.0 Job and job step identifiers moved from the Cratis.Orleans to the Cratis.Choreography namespace, which changes the wire identity of IObserver.ReportHandledEvents, ReportHandledEventsBatch and CaughtUp. Settle running jobs before upgrading.
v19.181.2 Kernel grain payloads moved from the JSON codec to generated Orleans serializers, which changes how they are written between silos, and observer and queue grain methods take a shared EventTypeSet instead of an event type list. IObserver.GetDefinition is removed (definitions are read from the event store's observer definition registry) and a per-silo grain service announces definition changes. Observers, the event log, the captures manager and the connected clients registry no longer arm grain timers: a per-silo supervisor runs their duties, which adds IObserver.CheckHealth and VerifyLiveSubscriptionAfterDeparture, IEventSequence.ReconcileSubscriptions, ICapturesManager.Reconcile and IConnectedClients.Revise. Stop all nodes, then start the new version.
